Yes — that feels right. I hit save, the pop-up closed, and I was back in my library with the finished card sitting there right away, plus that little "saved" confirmation that let me know it worked without getting in the way. Seeing the newest one appear immediately is reassuring.

The card has the right things at a glance too: the preview picture catches my eye, and then the little source icon and site name, the title, and the description underneath — that's enough for me to recognize a link and decide whether to open it. Nice and readable.

The only thing I'll flag for later, not now: once I start putting my own labels on links, I'd expect to see those labels on the card too, so I can tell at a glance how something's filed. But that's for when we get to labels — the card itself looks good.
